description: Implementation of TrustStoreInMemory class managing in-memory trust certificates, including adding, clearing, and retrieving trust information for certificates.

classes.name: TrustStoreInMemory
classes.description: In-memory store for managing trust certificates, including adding trust anchors, distrusted certificates, and querying trust status.

classes.name: TrustStoreInMemory::Entry
classes.description: Data structure representing a certificate and its associated trust level within the trust store.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the trust store has no entries.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::Clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the trust store.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::AddTrustAnchorWithExpiration
methods.description: Adds a trust anchor with enforced expiration.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::AddTrustAnchorWithConstraints
methods.description: Adds a trust anchor with enforced constraints.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::AddDistrustedCertificateForTest
methods.description: Adds a distrusted certificate for testing purposes.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::AddCertificateWithUnspecifiedTrust
methods.description: Adds a certificate with unspecified trust level.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates matching a given certificate.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::GetTrust
methods.description: Retrieves trust information for a given certificate.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::Contains
methods.description: Checks if a certificate exists in the trust store.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::AddCertificate
methods.description: Internal method to add a certificate with trust info.

methods.name: TrustStoreInMemory::GetEntry
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve an entry for a given certificate.
